test.body: This is a test notification for this phone.

member_joined.title: Someone joined your household
member_joined.body: Open members to see who's in your household.

member_left.title: Someone left your household
member_left.body: Open members to see who's in your household.

event_changed.title: The calendar changed
event_changed.body: An event in the next two weeks was added, moved or cancelled. Open the calendar to see it.

event_created.title: An event was added
event_created.body: Someone added an event in the next two weeks.

event_moved.title: An event was moved
event_moved.body: Someone moved an event in the next two weeks.

event_cancelled.title: An event was cancelled
event_cancelled.body: Someone cancelled an event in the next two weeks.

who_taking.title: Who's taking tomorrow's appointment?
who_taking.body: Nobody is taking it yet. Open it to choose who goes.

document_expiring.title: A document expires soon
document_expiring.body: Open Documents in the Household tab to see which one.

inbox.title: Inbox

empty.title: Nothing yet
empty.body: Reminders and household updates will show up here.

inbox.failed: Couldn't load notifications. Pull down to try again.

test.sent: Test sent. It arrives in a minute or so, after quiet hours if they're on.
test.failed: Couldn't send a test. Check your connection and try again.

eventDetails.title: Show event details
eventDetails.description: Adds the event's title and place to reminders on this phone. Off, they show only the kind, time and who's taking.

pantry.title: Pantry and staples
pantry.intro: Staples are things you always have at home, like salt and oil. They're left off your list. Anything you mark as already at home is listed here for this week.

have.title: At home this week
have.empty: Nothing marked as at home this week. Use “I already have this” on a list item.
have.undoHint: Puts {{name}} back on this week's list

staples.title: Staples
staples.removeHint: Removes {{name}} from staples, so the list includes it again
staples.readOnly: Only parents and family members can change staples.

assumed.title: Assumed at home
assumed.show: Shows the staples your plan uses
assumed.hide: Hides the staples your plan uses
assumed.add: Tap to add to this week's list

importRecipe.title: Import a recipe
importRecipe.linkHint: Paste the address of a recipe page.
importRecipe.textHint: Paste the ingredients and steps from a note, message or email.
importRecipe.addByHand: Add a recipe by hand instead
importRecipe.offline: You're offline. Importing a recipe needs a connection.

progress.title: Importing
progress.canLeave: This can take up to a minute. You can leave this screen: we'll keep going, and the recipe will be here when you come back.

review.title: Check the recipe
review.intro: Check the details, fix anything that's wrong, then save. Nothing is saved until you do.
review.sourceMentions: The recipe says it may contain {{allergens}}. Check the ingredients before you save.
review.discardBody: The imported recipe won't be saved.
review.gone: This import isn't available any more.

errors.unauthenticated: You're signed out. Sign in again to import.
errors.invalid_request: That didn't work. Check what you pasted and try again.
errors.forbidden: Your role in this household can't import recipes.
errors.rate_limited: That's a lot of imports in an hour. Try again a little later.
errors.quota_exceeded: You've used this month's imports. You can still add the recipe by hand.
errors.timeout: That took too long. Try again, or paste the recipe's text instead.
errors.parser_unavailable: Importing isn't available right now. You can add the recipe by hand.
errors.parse_failed: We couldn't read a recipe from that. Try again, or enter it manually.
errors.link_refused: That link can't be imported. Check it's a web page address starting with http.
errors.link_unreachable: We couldn't reach that page. Check the link, or paste the recipe's text instead.
errors.link_unsupported: That link isn't a web page we can read. Paste the recipe's text instead.
errors.link_too_large: That page is too large to import. Paste the recipe's text instead.
errors.no_recipe_found: We couldn't find a recipe there. Paste the recipe's text instead, or enter it manually.
errors.network: We lost the connection. Check you're online and try again.
errors.image_too_large: That image is too large to import. Try another one.

photo.hint: A cookbook page, a handwritten card or a screenshot of a recipe. One image per import.
photo.photosPermission: Parent Manager opens your photos when you choose a recipe photo or screenshot to import.
photo.cameraDenied: Parent Manager can't use the camera. Turn on camera access in Settings, or choose an image instead.
photo.imageFailed: We couldn't use that image. Try another one.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.offline: You're offline. Changes sync when you're back.
tasks.empty: Nothing to do yet. Tasks you and your partner add show here.

editor.title: New task
editor.failed: The task couldn't be saved. Try again.
editor.privacyHint: Your partner and anyone it's shared with can see this. Leave out health details.
editor.sharedHint: Family members and caregivers see it and can help.
editor.sharedAlways: Your tasks are shared with the household.

tasks.failed: That change couldn't be saved. Try again.
